title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: Lily, who is starting a flower shop in Boston, falls for Ryle, a charming neurosurgeon, just as a boy from her past returns. Her new relationship is not as safe as it looks.
readIf: you want an emotional, fast-reading romance that takes on a hard topic honestly.
skipIf: domestic violence is something you want to avoid, even in a romance.

pairings.reason: Another Hoover novel with a heavy emotional core and a second chance at love.
Another popular novel about domestic abuse hidden behind a good-looking life, with a mystery.
A classic that looks at abuse and a woman's path to freedom.
